name: FrenchModelVariant162_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant162_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a 256-point spiral of lines and a textured quad grow from the active part); for a non-negative request it selects the 20-byte descriptor indexed by the request, builds the spiral points and packs one texture, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant162.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-145/275 and Japanese images build the same source through model_variant/variant162_entry_usa.c and japanese/model_variant/variant162_entry_usa.c, which add the work-size printf and the 240-line height, and bind its data names 0x14, 0x28 and 0x28 higher. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
